description: In live rodents and brain slices, complex spikes in cerebellar Purkinje cells produced large negative extracellular potentials that suppressed simple spikes in neighboring Purkinje cells through ephaptic coupling, about 100 cells per climbing fiber (Han et al. 2018, as reported by McFadden).
limitations: Reported secondhand in McFadden 2021. The original study is not read here. It shows field coupling between neurons, not consciousness.

sources.quote: a single climbing fibre originating from the inferior olive was found to suppress the firing of around 100 Purkinje cells through ephaptic coupling
